versions.changelog:
Initial release of the board-visual skill with comprehensive standards for polished, consistent, and on-brand deliverables.

- Establishes a visual delivery standard for all client-facing materials (reports, dashboards, PPT, Word, Excel, PDF, HTML)
- Applies Morandi business palette (steel-blue + ochre), meeting-card layout, mixed chart types, and P0/P1/P2 prioritization
- Includes strict data discipline and detailed guidelines on typography, layout, chart/table design, and export/formatting requirements
- Reference files provide complete rules, prohibited items, self-checklists, and ready-to-use color tokens
